title: Russian Drone Strikes National Academy of Sciences in Kyiv, Killing and Injuring Civilians
detail: A Russian drone crashed into the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine in Kyiv, killing and injuring civilians in a direct strike on one of Ukraine's most prominent scientific institutions. The attack represents a continued pattern of Russian strikes on civilian and cultural infrastructure in the Ukrainian capital.

title: Zelenskyy Accuses Russia of Terrorising Civilians as Fresh Strikes Kill at Least Eight
detail: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemned Russia for terrorising Ukrainian civilians as fresh Russian strikes claimed the lives of at least eight people. The strikes represent a continued pattern of Russian attacks on civilian targets across Ukraine.

title: Strong Explosions in Kyiv as Air Force Confirms Ballistic Missile Attack
detail: Strong explosions were reported in Kyiv late on September 28, 2026, as Ukraine's air force confirmed the capital was being targeted by ballistic missiles. The attack represents a continued pattern of Russian ballistic missile strikes against the Ukrainian capital.
